system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for verifying the Paxos consensus algorithm specification. It provides finite instantiations of the constants, definitions for checking the inductive invariant, and support for verifying that the Paxos algorithm implements the abstract voting specification. It also includes a liveness specification for checking progress.
actors_and_components: The module declares three model acceptors and two model values. Quorums are defined as the three possible majority subsets of the three acceptors. The module extends the base Paxos specification and provides definitions needed for TLC model checking.
state_variables: Same as the base Paxos specification: per-acceptor participation threshold, per-acceptor highest vote ballot, per-acceptor highest vote value, and the message set. The type invariant is reformulated so that the message set is declared using set membership (element of power set) rather than subset notation, as required for TLC initial predicates.
initial_state: For standard model checking, the initial state comes from the base Paxos specification. For inductive invariant checking, the initial state is the reformulated invariant itself, allowing TLC to explore all invariant-satisfying states.
actions: Same as the base Paxos specification: Phase 1a (prepare), Phase 1b (promise), Phase 2a (accept-request), and Phase 2b (acceptance). For liveness checking, weak fairness conditions are applied to Phase 1a for the maximum ballot, Phase 2a for the maximum ballot with every value, and Phase 1b and Phase 2b for specific acceptors.
safety_properties: The inductive invariant is decomposed into four separate conjuncts for easier debugging: (1) type correctness, (2) consistency between per-acceptor vote tracking and the derived vote set, (3) constraints on message contents including that promise messages reflect actual votes and accept-request messages are justified by quorum safety, and (4) the invariant of the abstract voting specification. Additionally, the module checks that the refinement mapping to the voting specification is preserved.
liveness_properties: Under the fairness conditions, eventually some value is chosen (the derived chosen set in the voting specification becomes non-empty).
model_bounds: Three acceptors, two values, quorums are all majority subsets, and a configurable maximum ballot number that bounds the ballot range to zero through that maximum. Symmetry is exploited over the acceptor and value sets.
additional_assumptions: This module is a companion to the base Paxos specification. Multiple specifications are provided for different checking modes: standard specification checking, inductive invariant checking, and liveness checking. The module also defines a property asserting that every step preserves the voting specification's next-state relation under the refinement mapping.
